酸度影响土壤中铝的化学形态。较酸时，铝通常更容易成为根可吸收的形态；但土里没有足: Acidity influences aluminum chemistry in soil. Lower pH generally makes aluminum more available to roots, but acidity cannot create aluminum where little is present.

根吸收可利用的铝，再通过植物的运输与储存过程，让一部分铝进入萼片细胞的液泡。植物: Roots take up available aluminum. Plant transport and storage processes allow some of it to reach sepal-cell vacuoles; those processes also influence the final color.
一些大花绣球的花青素会与铝及辅色素形成蓝色复合物。没有足够铝时，同一类有色色素通: In some bigleaf hydrangeas, anthocyanin combines with aluminum and copigments to form a blue complex. With insufficient aluminum, the colored pigment tends toward pink; intermediate cases can appear purple.
一团花序由许多小花组成。最显眼的大块彩色结构是萼片，颜色来自细胞内部。花龄、品种: The flower head contains many small flowers. Its large, showy colored parts are sepals, with color inside their cells. Age, cultivar and variation among cells can create different shades in one head.

这里讨论能发生蓝变的大花绣球，以及部分山绣球的相关机制。并非所有绣球种类或所有品: This page concerns blue-capable bigleaf hydrangeas and related mechanisms in some mountain hydrangeas. The pathway does not apply to every species or cultivar; age-related color changes in panicle hydrangeas are a different process.
土壤 pH 改变铝的可利用性；花青素、铝离子、辅色素和液泡内部环境共同影响显色。: Soil pH affects aluminum availability. Anthocyanin, aluminum ions, copigments and the vacuolar environment together influence color. Soil pH and vacuolar pH describe different locations and are not interchangeable.
主要花青素为飞燕草素 3-O-葡萄糖苷。辅色素包括酰基奎宁酸类。此式只标出参与者: The main anthocyanin is delphinidin 3-O-glucoside. Copigments include acylquinic acids. This expression lists participants, not a full structure, stoichiometry or fixed equilibrium constant.
颜色在细胞的液泡里形成，图中的连接符号表示复合关系，不是分子的真实形状。: Color develops in cell vacuoles. The connected symbols represent complex formation, not the molecules’ actual shapes.

改变土壤条件后，铝的可利用性、根部吸收、植株运输与花的发育都需要时间。园艺中的可: After soil conditions change, aluminum availability, root uptake, transport and flower development all take time. Visible changes may wait until another bloom cycle or longer. Sliders set the next cycle rather than instantly recoloring an open flower.
